title: CMS Entry Save Fails with "Reference Cycle Detected" Error
alternate_search_terms: two entries referencing each other CMS

extracted_facts.problem: The customer's entry failed to save with a "reference cycle detected" error whenever they tried to link two entries to each other through a reference field.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The content model allowed entry A to reference entry B and entry B to reference entry A through the same field, creating a circular reference the CMS correctly refused to save.
resolution_steps: Restructure the relationship to use a one-directional reference instead of a bidirectional one.
Handle the reverse link through a separate lookup field.
